stories.headline: Russia fires 186 drones; a Kyiv-region block is destroyed
stories.summary: Air defences downed or suppressed 161 of 186 strike drones (72 of them jet-powered), fired from eight directions. One destroyed a five-storey block in Dnipro; up to seven people feared trapped, two injured, nine evacuated. (Ukrainian Air Force via Reuters)

stories.headline: Climate deal lands with no mention of fossil fuels
stories.summary: The final text 'excels' the Dubai pact whole, keeps the 35%-electricity-by-2035 goal, drops the $120bn adaptation target and is the first to admit 1.5°C will be overshot. Hoekstra: 'a good deal or no deal'. (Reuters, BBC, The Guardian)

stories.headline: Iran claims two US radars hit; Bahrain denies it
stories.summary: The IRGC says it destroyed two Patriot radars on Saturday night. Bahrain's foreign ministry answered on Sunday: the target was a civilian industrial site — a fire, no injuries — and a violation of its sovereignty. (Khaleej Times, Al Jazeera)
